title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 17A, a Firm Transportation Agreement with the City of Boston, Boston Public Schools (Phase V).
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (DTE 04-GC-5)
